verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own controls that keep sensitive AI content out of traces. Prompt and response content is off by default and is captured only through the `data_collection` option. Developers can also turn AI content off per integration with `include_prompts=False` or `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs` while leaving other PII on. These are coarse on/off collection toggles, not selective masking or redaction of specific sensitive values before storage. missing for 10: field-level masking or redaction rules (e.g., scrubbing hooks or pattern-based redaction) for trace data, coverage of non-AI span data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces

citations.quote: Prompt and response content is off by default — use the `gen_ai` key of the [`data_collection` option](/platforms/python/configuration/options/#data_collection) to capture it.
To keep other PII on but turn AI content off, set `include_prompts=False` on the integration.
You can also set `recordInputs` / `recordOutputs` on a specific AI integration.
